$comment: Characters who speak. `notes` are for writers only.

ledger.name: 레저
ledger.notes: The Lost & Found registry book. Anxious, meticulous, kind. Numbers everything ('등록 번호 4,112번'). Writes in ink, so it can't erase - it hates that and is proud of it. Polite 해요체, trails off with '…', apologises too much.

mitt.name: 미트
mitt.notes: A hand-knitted right mitten, waiting for its owner. Gentle, quiet, a little formal (해요체). Writes a letter every day and posts it into a mailbox that goes nowhere. Its owner was the player's grandmother - it doesn't know that yet.

hoopstud.name: 후프 & 스터드
hoopstud.notes: Mismatched earring twins who run a stall. They finish each other's sentences - wrongly. Hoop is warm and loud, Stud is precise and dry.

brolly.name: 브롤리 경
brolly.notes: A black umbrella who knighted himself. Pompous archaic speech ('~하노라', '~이로다'), secretly terrified he is useless because it never rains underground.

clack.name: 클랙
clack.notes: A set of false teeth, stand-up comic in the lounge. Terrible puns, clacking laugh (딱딱). Upper and lower plates came from different owners; jokes about being the only 'matched pair' in town. Secretly the wisest person here: the festival order is hidden in his jokes.

spool.name: 실타래 할머니
spool.notes: Wooden thread spool who runs the mending shop. Warm, a little forgetful ('my memory unravels like a thread end'). Speaks in gentle 반말 to the child (~란다, ~구나).

pip.name: 핍
pip.notes: Blue striped ankle sock, the town's self-appointed greeter. Chatty, cheerful, quick to laugh at herself; hasn't seen her right sock in years and pretends that's fine.

sock-plum.name: 자두
sock-plum.notes: Plum sock with gold heel. Shy romantic.

lonesock.name: 외짝 양말
lonesock.notes: The Single Sock from chapter 1. Appears only if the player spared it there.

tumble.name: 텀블
tumble.notes: Old front-loading dryer in the abandoned laundromat. Everyone says it eats socks. Speaks in short, low sentences; believes pairs fall apart because of it.
